scripts.start: rm -rf .esbuild && bash scripts/with-local-env.sh npx serverless offline --httpPort 8800 --websocketPort 8801 --noPrependStageInUrl
scripts.start:win: if exist .esbuild rmdir /s /q .esbuild & node scripts/with-local-env.js node ..\..\node_modules\serverless\bin\serverless.js offline --httpPort 8800 --websocketPort 8801 --noPrependStageInUrl
scripts.package:dev: bash scripts/with-local-env.sh node scripts/validate-deploy-env.mjs dev && bash scripts/with-local-env.sh bash scripts/prepare-ffmpeg-layer.sh dev && bash scripts/with-local-env.sh npx serverless package --stage dev
scripts.deploy:dev: bash scripts/with-local-env.sh node scripts/validate-deploy-env.mjs dev && bash scripts/with-local-env.sh bash scripts/prepare-ffmpeg-layer.sh dev && bash scripts/with-local-env.sh npx serverless deploy --stage dev && SMOKE_STAGE=dev bash scripts/with-local-env.sh node scripts/smoke-cors.mjs && SMOKE_STAGE=dev bash scripts/with-local-env.sh node scripts/smoke-ffmpeg-overlay.mjs
scripts.deploy:prod: bash scripts/with-local-env.sh node scripts/validate-deploy-env.mjs prod && bash scripts/with-local-env.sh bash scripts/prepare-ffmpeg-layer.sh prod && bash scripts/with-local-env.sh npx serverless deploy --stage prod && SMOKE_STAGE=prod bash scripts/with-local-env.sh node scripts/smoke-cors.mjs && SMOKE_STAGE=prod bash scripts/with-local-env.sh node scripts/smoke-ffmpeg-overlay.mjs
